card.text: A 2.85-Earth-radius planet with a 20.52-day year in HD 110067's resonant chain.

introduction.text: HD 110067 d is one of six transiting sub-Neptunes. Its radius is 2.852 Earth radii and its year lasts 20.52 days.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the measured radius. Neutral gray marks the unknown surface colour; lighting comes from the host star.
